about_the_game:
🏷️ Short Description (for Demo page)

This is a Demo version of Dungeon Brawl. Try out a limited selection of heroes, skills, and relics in a 30-minute co-op roguelike experience. Choose your build, fight through enemy waves, and team up with friends in this anime-style hack & slash action game.

✅ This Demo includes:

  • 10 anime-style heroes

  • 50+ skills & 80+ relics

  • Up to 30-minute co-op session

  • 20 waves of enemies, including  boss battle

  • Supports keyboard/mouse and controller

🧭 About This Demo

🎮 What You Can Expect in the Demo

This Demo version of Dungeon Brawl lets you experience a slice of our full co-op roguelike action gameplay. It’s a 30-minute session where you and your friends can build your characters, fight waves of enemies, and try out the early-stage combat systems in an anime-style dungeon arena.

You’ll control one of 10 unlockable anime heroes, each with their own unique active and passive skills. Combine those with a pool of over 50 skills and 80 relics to shape your strategy — from heavy melee to spellcasting or defensive support.

📌 Please note: This is a limited demo and does not represent the full content or all systems of the final release.

👥 Demo Features

  • 🎭 Playable Heroes: 10 anime-style characters with unique skill sets

  • 🌀 Skill System: 50+ active/passive skills, mix and match

  • ✨ Relic Drops: 80+ randomized relics with synergies

  • ⚔️ Combat: Fight through 20 waves of enemies, including boss encounter

  • 🤝 Multiplayer: Up to 4-player online co-op

  • 🎮 Input Support: Keyboard & mouse, or controller

  • 🌍 Languages: English, Simplified Chinese

  • 📅 Estimated Session: 20–30 minutes per run

🚫 Not Available in Demo

To avoid confusion with the full game, here’s what’s not included in this demo:

  • Full hero roster (demo only includes 4 of 50+ planned heroes)

  • Advanced challenge modes, full relic/item pool

  • Final game polish, performance optimization, or narrative content

  • Progression, account-level upgrades, or unlocks

  • Steam achievements or Steam Cloud

  • Additional language support (only English & Simplified Chinese for now)

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 | AMD Radeon HD 7950

Recommended:

short_description: Dungeon Brawl is a casual-yet-intense online co-op roguelike action game! Choose from dozens of anime-style heroes, freely combine hundreds of skills and relics, and team up with your friends to carve through hordes of enemies. Build your own fighting style and dive into the blood-soaked chaos!

English*, Simplified Chinese*
